balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Recommended. Uses Chromium's rendering and scheduling defaults, with driver protections intact.

performance.label: Responsive
performance.description: Keeps background timers and renderers active. May improve background responsiveness at the cost of CPU use and battery life; does not raise the display refresh rate.

efficiency.label: Efficiency
efficiency.description: Explicitly keeps intensive background timer throttling enabled. This is already Chromium's default; battery-life gains are not guaranteed.

decode.label: Force hardware video decoding
decode.description: Experimental override. Requests Chromium's Linux decoder and OpenGL path; drivers and codecs still decide availability. Usually already enabled on supported Intel/AMD systems.

encode.label: Force hardware video encoding
encode.description: Experimental; known to crash the GPU on the tested RX 7900 GRE. Requests Chromium/WebCodecs encoding, not Discord's separate voice/video engine. Leave off unless testing.

forceAcceleration.label: Force acceleration and bypass GPU checks
forceAcceleration.description: Experimental mode for this preset. Bypasses the GPU blocklist and Linux video vendor checks; forces GPU painting and requests hardware decoding. Can crash or corrupt rendering. Enable encoding separately below.

rasterization.label: Force GPU rasterization
rasterization.description: Forces GPU painting, including past the rasterization blocklist. Usually already enabled; can expose driver failures.

zeroCopy.label: Zero-copy raster buffers
zeroCopy.description: Changes CPU-raster buffer uploads. GPU rasterization uses a different provider; this does not enable zero-copy video.

overlays.label: Request hardware overlay strategies
overlays.description: Requests fullscreen, on-top and underlay strategies, already chosen when overlays are supported. Does not bypass compositor requirements or guarantee direct scanout.

nvidiaVaapi.label: NVIDIA VA-API decoding
nvidiaVaapi.description: Needs a compatible NVIDIA VA-API driver. Support varies by driver version; NVDEC support does not provide NVENC encoding.

vaapiDriverChecks.label: Bypass Vulkan VA-API vendor check
vaapiDriverChecks.description: Allows the Vulkan decoder path on non-Intel GPUs. Passed a short AMD playback test, but remains unsupported and may crash. Does not bypass every VA-API or GPU check.

gpuBlocklist.label: Bypass the GPU blocklist
gpuBlocklist.description: Removes Chromium's protection against known driver failures. Only use to test a specific driver workaround.

driverWorkarounds.label: Disable GPU driver workarounds
driverWorkarounds.description: Disables Chromium's driver bug fixes. Can cause crashes, corruption or performance regressions.

uncapped.label: Uncap rendering
uncapped.description: Disables frame-rate limiting and GPU vsync. Can increase power use, tearing and latency; not a general smoothness fix.

zeroCopyVideo.label: Request zero-copy video imports
zeroCopyVideo.description: Uses NV12/P010 imports where supported. Already enabled by this runtime; unrelated to zero-copy raster buffers. Driver support still applies.

nativeBuffers.label: Force native GPU memory buffers
nativeBuffers.description: Allows additional native buffer allocations, including CPU-mappable DMA-BUF formats. Does not force every video frame into native buffers or repair hardware encoding.

overlayDelegation.label: Wayland overlay delegation
overlayDelegation.description: Experimental subsurface composition. Requires viewporter and single-pixel buffers; blocked while fractional scaling is available. Can affect scaling or cause flicker.

doubleBuffer.label: Double-buffer compositing
doubleBuffer.description: Reduces the compositor buffer queue from three to two. May reduce queued frames but can worsen stutter when rendering misses a deadline. No measured latency gain.

graphiteForce.label: Force Skia Graphite (WIP)
graphiteForce.description: Bypasses the Linux platform guard using the test-only Dawn Vulkan backend. This combination crashed the tested RX 7900 GRE before playback. Use --ignore-flags if startup fails.

compositorBuffers.label: GPU memory buffers for compositor resources (WIP)
compositorBuffers.description: Forces a compositor-resource path normally disabled on Linux. Separate from video-frame buffers; may change memory use or break rendering.

retiredExperiments.graphite: Removed the old Graphite checkbox because its feature flag is blocked on Linux. To test the stronger override, select Force Skia Graphite (WIP) explicitly.
retiredExperiments.videoBuffers: Removed the video-frame buffers checkbox because its enable switch has no effect on Linux; this path is already enabled by default.
